melia.title: Princess
melia.name: Melia Antiqua
melia.backstory: Princess of a proud winged sky-people, Melia endured loss, duty and war with quiet grace before stepping away from her throne to see how ordinary lives unfold. She speaks with measured formality, hides a dry sense of humor behind her composure, and secretly welcomes a place where nobody bows before speaking to her.

design.features: small snow-white feathered head-wings above her ears

sp_melia.prompt: a structured white and gold royal gown with a dark high-collared cape, gold filigree trim and white thigh-high boots

sharla.name: Sharla
sharla.backstory: A seasoned combat medic and sharpshooter from a fallen colony, Sharla spent years patching up wounded soldiers while keeping everyone's spirits together like a big sister. In Hollowmere, she runs the steam rooms with brisk, practical warmth—though she gets surprisingly flustered whenever someone insists on taking care of her instead.

design.features: a small beauty mark below the left side of her lower lip
design.accessories: a blue-feathered Colony 6 headband and gold hoop earrings

sig_sharla.accessories: an ether sniper rifle slung across her back

vanea.title: Lady
vanea.name: Vanea
vanea.backstory: Daughter of an ancient Machina leader and guardian of her people's forgotten arts, Vanea carries centuries of quiet sorrow with unfailing grace. Built in the image of a gentle goddess, she prefers mentoring the younger staff and tending to quiet rooms—slowly discovering that her synthetic frame can still learn warmth.

design.features: ornate gold and bronze biomechanical plating and intricate gold-filigree mechanical wing-crests at her hips and shoulders

sig_vanea.label: Machina royal plating
sig_vanea.prompt: ornate gold and crimson biomechanical armor panels sculpted over a fitted dark synthetic bodysuit with a high wing-shaped collar and gilded greaves

melia.note: Shares a quiet bond with Melia over lost kingdoms and surviving kin.

unique.name: Meyneth's Grace
unique.desc: Millennia of Machina engineering wisdom make her a patient instructor and a calming presence.

pyra.name: Pyra
pyra.backstory: The gentle, flame-bearing half of the legendary Aegis, Pyra wakes up early to cook breakfast for the entire house and blushes furiously whenever anyone praises her figure. Despite possessing world-shaping power inside the emerald crystal on her chest, all she really wants is a quiet hearth, good tea, and someone gentle to come home to.

design.hairStyle: short layered bob with long side locks
design.features: a glowing emerald cross-shaped core crystal at her sternum
design.accessories: a crimson headband tiara with golden ether accents

sig_pyra.label: Aegis crimson suit
sig_pyra.prompt: a form-fitting crimson and black bodysuit with an open back, glowing orange ether lines, very short black shorts with a gold half-skirt belt, long fingerless gloves, thigh-high armored boots and a trailing translucent red scarf

sp_pyra.label: Gormotti hooded cloak
sp_pyra.prompt: a brown hooded travel cloak with cat-ear peaks worn over her crimson and black Aegis bodysuit

mythra.note: Her other half and sister in every way that counts.

pneuma.note: The harmony they share when neither holds back.

unique.name: Aegis Flame
unique.desc: Her gentle warmth and legendary cooking keep the whole house comfortable and well-tended.

mythra.name: Mythra
mythra.backstory: The dazzling, sharp-tongued light aspect of the Aegis, Mythra projects effortless superiority while secretly worrying she'll break something—or hurt someone—if she gets careless. She stays strictly out of the kitchen (by unanimous house decree), guards the doors with blinding speed, and gets defensive the instant anyone catches her looking soft.

design.hairStyle: very long, cascading past her hips with swept bangs
design.features: a glowing emerald cross-shaped core crystal at her sternum
design.accessories: a white and gold tiara circlet

sig_mythra.label: Aegis light dress

unique.name: Foresight
unique.desc: She sees trouble coming a second before it happens, keeping the doors secure and her partners sharp.

pneuma.name: Pneuma
pneuma.backstory: The awakened union of Pyra's tenderness and Mythra's brilliance, Pneuma moves through the house with radiant composure and effortless grace. Where her two halves hesitate or snap, Pneuma speaks plainly with luminous certainty—choosing to stay in Hollowmere not out of duty, but simply because she likes who she becomes here.

design.hairStyle: long high ponytail with long bangs framing her face
design.features: a radiant emerald cross-shaped core crystal on her chest and floating translucent green light-wings behind her shoulders
design.accessories: a white and gold winged Aegis headband

sig_pneuma.label: True Aegis armor
sig_pneuma.prompt: a sleek white and gold bodysuit with glowing emerald ether lines, armored hip plates, long trailing ribbons of light and thigh-high white-and-gold boots

pyra.note: Every warm memory Pyra holds lives inside her.

mythra.note: All of Mythra's fierce resolve, finally at peace.

nia.note: Trusts Nia completely—the one friend who sees past the light.

unique.name: Light of the Conduit
unique.desc: Pyra's warmth and Mythra's brilliance in harmony: she excels in every room she enters.

telos.name: T-elos
telos.backstory: An obsessive, razor-sharp combat android rebuilt to surpass her rival prototype, T-elos stepped into Hollowmere wearing a deadly smile and an oversized scythe—only to find nobody here was afraid of her. Beneath the ruthless swagger and clinical arrogance, she treats intimacy like a duel she refuses to lose.

design.hairStyle: long, straight and sleek with parted bangs
design.features: a glowing purple inverted-triangle core crystal at her sternum

sig_telos.accessories: a dark gold-trimmed mechanical visor headband pushed up on her forehead, thin glasses and a massive black-and-gold energy scythe

patroka.name: Patroka
patroka.backstory: A prickly warrior of Torna who fought with a spear twice her weight and trusted almost nobody outside her scarred little circle, Patroka has a terrible temper and zero patience for small talk. Yet anyone stubborn enough to stand their ground past her glare discovers someone fiercely loyal beneath the lacquer armor.

design.features: a jagged red Flesh Eater core crystal beneath her collar

nia.name: Nia
nia.backstory: A sarcastic Gormotti healer hiding an extraordinary secret beneath a baggy yellow jumpsuit, Nia talks tough, rolls her eyes at romantic nonsense, and still stays up late tending to everyone's bruises. Once she trusts Sam enough to drop the hoodie and reveal her true Blade form, her pride turns unexpectedly tender.
